Theme.Name: Use Zintharion theme
Theme.Hint: Applies the blue, teal and gold colors to character sheets (only for you).

Logo.Name: Sheet crest
Logo.Hint: Image shown in the character sheet header.

ShowRank.Name: Show rank on sheet
ShowRank.Hint: Shows the rank badge (F, E, D... Ω) next to the character name.

ExhaustionMax.Name: Maximum Exhaustion levels
ExhaustionMax.Hint: How many Exhaustion levels exist. The last level is marked as death on the sheet. Zintharion default: 10.

XpMenu.Name: Experience Table
XpMenu.Label: Edit XP table
XpMenu.Hint: Sets how much XP each level requires. The number of rows sets the maximum level.

RankMenu.Name: Rank Table
RankMenu.Label: Edit ranks
RankMenu.Hint: Sets the starting level and colors of each rank.

MaxSpellLevel.Name: Maximum spell level
MaxSpellLevel.Hint: Highest spell level that exists in the world (9 = standard D&D). Levels above 9 get their own spell slots, which you set manually in the Spell Slots configuration.

SiteMenu.Name: Zintharion website
SiteMenu.Label: Open sync
SiteMenu.Hint: Lists the website characters and lets you Receive (before a session) and Send (after a session).

SiteUrl.Name: Website address
SiteUrl.Hint: Zintharion website address, e.g. https://zintharion.vercel.app (shown on your website profile).

SiteToken.Name: Website token
SiteToken.Hint: Your personal token, created at Profile → Foundry integration. Stored only on this computer.

SiteCheck.Name: Notify on load
SiteCheck.Hint: When the world opens, tells you if there are characters to receive or send.

ConcExpanded.Name: Enable Expanded Concentration
ConcExpanded.Hint: Casters can maintain several Concentration spells (limit = highest spellcasting modifier), make a single save with a higher DC per maintained spell and, failing by 10 or more with 2+ spells, suffer an Arcane Explosion.

ConcDcMods.Name: DC modifier per maintained spell
ConcDcMods.Hint: Values added to the Concentration DC, comma-separated: 1st = 1 spell, 2nd = 2 spells, and so on. Beyond the last, the last value repeats. Default: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25.

AnomalyTable.Name: Anomaly Table (optional)
AnomalyTable.Hint: UUID of a Roll Table used to suggest a Magical Anomaly after an Arcane Explosion (e.g. RollTable.abc123). Empty = notice only.

AnomalyVisibility.Name: Magical Anomaly notice
AnomalyVisibility.Hint: Who sees the Temporary Magical Anomaly message.

XP.Title: Experience Table — Zintharion
XP.Hint: Total XP required to reach each level. Level 1 always starts at 0. The number of rows is the world's maximum level.
XP.ImportPrompt: Paste a list of numbers below, e.g.: [0, 300, 900, 2700]
XP.Saved: XP table saved. Maximum level is now {max}.
XP.ErrorOrder: XP must increase at every level. Fix the rows marked in red.
XP.ErrorImport: Could not read the JSON. Use a list of numbers, e.g.: [0, 300, 900].
XP.ErrorMin: The table needs at least 1 level.
XP.ResetConfirm: Restore the default Zintharion XP table? (30 levels; level 3 = 1,000 XP)

Ranks.Title: Rank Table — Zintharion
Ranks.Hint: Each rank starts at the given level and lasts until the level before the next rank.
Ranks.ErrorOrder: Starting levels must be unique and increasing, and the rank cannot be empty.
Ranks.EmblemHint: Put emblem images in Data/{folder} named after the rank (e.g. F.png, SS.webp, omega.png). They are found automatically when the world loads or with the "Find emblems" button. You can also pick an image manually in the Emblem column.

Sync.NotConfigured: Set the website address and your token in the Zintharion module settings.
Sync.Unreachable: Could not reach the website ({url}). Check the address and your connection.
Sync.NoCharacters: No characters available for this token.
Sync.PullTooltip: Receive from website (update this sheet from the website)
Sync.PullTooltipUnlinked: Receive from website (choose the website character)
Sync.PushTooltip: Send to website (update the website from this sheet)
Sync.PushTooltipUnlinked: Send to website (choose the website character)
Sync.ConflictHint: This website character is already linked to another Foundry actor (maybe in another world). Link it to this actor from now on?
Sync.PushApplied: {name} sent to the website ({count} field(s) changed).
Sync.PushPending: {name} sent. Staff will review it on the website.
Sync.ImportHint: Creates an actor with the website data. Class, species and background are imported afterwards with Plutonium (the sheet shows what is missing).
Sync.InboxNotice: Zintharion website: {receive} character(s) to receive, {send} send request(s), {newOnes} new character(s) to import.
Sync.XpDone: XP table sent to the website ({max} levels).
Sync.BuildTitle: New sheet: build it with Plutonium
Sync.BuildHint: This sheet came from the website at level 0. Import what was chosen on the website with Plutonium (abilities and skills are chosen there). Once the class is added, the website XP is applied. When done, click Send so the website copies the sheet.
Sync.BuildNoPlutonium: Plutonium is not active or not available on this sheet.
Sync.XpTooltip: The website starts using this world's XP table. It is also sent automatically when you save the table.
Sync.XpFailed: Could not send the XP table to the website: {error}
Sync.ConfiguredHint: {name} already has a class in Foundry and was never synced. To keep the sheet intact, Foundry wins: it will be sent to the website first. After that, Receive and Send work normally. Send now?
Sync.CreatedLevel0: {name} created at level 0 with only the name, portrait and texts from the website. Build class, species and background with Plutonium, then click Send.
Sync.BuildFinished: {name}: build finished. Click Send to update the website.
Sync.RestoreHint: The website has the full sheet of {site} (class, features, spells, items and effects) from the last send. It will replace everything on {name}. Continue?
Sync.Restored: {name}: full sheet restored from the website ({count} field(s) updated with website changes made after the send).
Sync.ImportPullFailed: {name} was created, but the website sheet did not arrive: {error}. Click Receive on the sheet to try again.

Concentration.Breakdown: Base DC {base} + {count} maintained spells (+{modifier}) = DC {dc}
Concentration.FailedBy: Failed by {margin} (rolled {total} vs DC {dc}). The spells break all at once.
Concentration.SelfDamage: {name} takes the full damage (ignores force resistance, not immunity). Already applied.
Concentration.AreaSave: Creatures within {radius} ft: Dexterity save DC {dc}. Fail: full damage. Success: half. Use the damage card below to apply it.
Concentration.Conditions: The caster is Prone, Incapacitated until the end of their next turn and gains +4 Exhaustion.
Concentration.IncapacitatedHint: Arcane Explosion: incapacitated until the end of the next turn. Removed automatically in combat.
Concentration.AnomalyText: {name}'s explosion left an anomaly in the area. Spells that were maintained:
Concentration.ExplosionError: Error resolving the Arcane Explosion. Check the console (F12).
